titulo_ja: ままに と ずじまい (3)

のぞんで.es: (forma て de のぞむ) deseando

やみません.es: no dejo de; no puedo dejar de

しんじて.es: creyendo (forma て de しんじる)

texto: To say that a strong and constant feeling does not go away: verb in the form of hes + **やまない**: **ともだち の しあわせ を のぞんで やみません** (I do not fail to desire the happiness of my friend).
It is only used with feelings like "(think)," "" (wish) "or" (believe). "
It's a very formal and written form.
It is used in letters and speeches.
